playstyle.identity: Corki is a poke ADC whose damage is mostly magic despite building AD. His Package lets him roam with a devastating zone control ability.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive converts most damage to magic. Q is a bomb. W dashes and burns. E shreds armor in a cone. R fires rockets (Big One every 3rd). Package spawns in base - pick up for mega W dash. Poke with R, all-in with W, Package for roams.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Corki spikes with first Package (8 min) and Trinity Force. Crit and AD scale his magic damage. He's strong at poke and bursting squishies.

passive.name: Hextech Munitions
passive.summary: Auto attacks deal mostly magic damage. Periodically, The Package spawns in base.
passive.details: Corki's auto attacks deal 80% magic and 20% physical damage. Periodically, The Package spawns in base - picking it up empowers Valkyrie.

abilities.name: Phosphorus Bomb
abilities.summary: Throw a bomb that damages and reveals enemies.
abilities.details: Corki throws a bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies and revealing them for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Valkyrie
abilities.summary: Dash and leave a burning trail. Package: massive dash that knocks aside and burns.
abilities.details: Corki dashes in a direction, leaving a fire trail. With Package: Special Delivery is a longer dash that knocks enemies aside and leaves a massive burning zone.

abilities.name: Gatling Gun
abilities.summary: Fire a cone of bullets that shred armor and magic resist.
abilities.details: Corki fires his gatling gun in a cone, dealing damage over time and shredding enemy armor and magic resist with each tick.

abilities.name: Missile Barrage
abilities.summary: Fire rockets that poke; every 3rd is a Big One with larger damage and AoE.
abilities.details: Corki fires a missile that damages enemies. He stores missiles over time (up to 7). Every third missile is a Big One, dealing increased damage in a larger area.
